definitions.gloss: historical anecdote, old story, classical tale
definitions.explanation: A story or anecdote from ancient times, particularly from Chinese classics, that has been passed down and often serves as the origin of a proverb or set phrase.

examples.english: There is a historical anecdote behind this phrase.

examples.japanese: {故事|こじ}⟦{成語|せいご}→成語：23690_seigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write using classical four-character idioms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{由来|ゆらい}→由来：05451_yurai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{故事|こじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことわざ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Many historical anecdotes originating from Chinese classics remain in Japanese proverbs.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in the compound {故事|こじ}⟦{成語|せいご}→成語：23690_seigo⟧ (classical idiom based on a historical anecdote) or {故事|こじ}⟦{来歴|らいれき}→来歴：15072_raireki⟧ (history and origin). Many {故事|こじ}⟦{成語|せいご}→成語：23690_seigo⟧ in Japanese come from Chinese classical literature, such as ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧ (contradiction) and {五十歩百歩|ごじっぽひゃっぽ} (pot calling the kettle black).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {故事|こじ}⟦{成語|せいご}→成語：23690_seigo⟧: idiom based on a historical anecdote
- {故事|こじ}⟦{来歴|らいれき}→来歴：15072_raireki⟧: history and origin
- {故事|こじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ちなむ→ちなむ：10386_chinamu⟧: to be based on a historical anecdote
- {故事|こじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ならう: to follow a historical precedent

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{誇示|こじ}→誇示：07967_koji⟧ (display, showing off), which shares the same reading.
